data.one_liner: IndexedDB API implementation on top of sqflite for Flutter and Dart VM
data.what_it_does: Provides an IndexedDB-compatible database interface built on top of sqflite, enabling code to use IndexedDB patterns across mobile, web, and desktop platforms. It also includes a simplified wrapper API called SDB.
use_when: You need an IndexedDB-compatible API sharing code across web, mobile, and desktop
You want to store structured data locally using sqflite as the backend engine
avoid_when: You need a high-performance native ORM or complex relational SQL queries
You prefer standard sqflite or drift APIs over IndexedDB concepts
strengths: Brings IndexedDB API support to mobile and desktop via sqflite
Works across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Performance is constrained by running an IndexedDB emulation layer over SQLite
API style follows IndexedDB rather than native Dart/SQL idioms

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard SQLite database operations directly instead of an IndexedDB wrapper layer.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a robust, type-safe reactive SQL database library for Flutter.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are looking for a fast, lightweight NoSQL key-value database.
